gen-dafont-dited-fs-gambetta: Gambetta reads bookish and graceful, with a stroke that shifts gently. Dited packs its digital shapes hip to hip, which is its best trick, while Gambetta saves its wide channels for text, though not for endless paragraphs.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-amiko: Chunky and loud, Dogica pulls its lowercase up near capital height while Amiko brings tall strokes and terminals pointing outward. Give Amiko a modest size and it stays out of the way.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-athiti: Dogica stretches heavy words out with wide tracking, its lowercase rising nearly to capital height and every curve left visibly open. Athiti stays approachable, with one stroke width that keeps text moving.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-atkinson-hyperlegib: Heavy and commanding, Dogica stretches its tracking wide and lifts its lowercase close to capital height. Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono is approachable, its open counters leaving text room to breathe line after line.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Wide tracking gives Dogica its stretched-out stance, with lowercase rising close to capital height. Carrois Gothic SC holds capitals and lowercase at nearly matching heights, a contemporary steadiness that grounds the loud heading.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-duru-sans: Duru Sans reads clean and modern, with wide openings on small letters and bodies that dominate the line. Beside heavy Dogica, that quiet openness is what makes the pairing work.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-funnel-sans: Loud and wide, Dogica stretches heavy letters across the line with lowercase near capital height. But Funnel Sans keeps stroke widths uniform, with no calligraphic swell, and that restraint is the pairing's draw.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-hedvig-letters-sans: Heavy and wide, Dogica lifts its lowercase close to capital height and leaves a clear opening at every curve end. Hedvig Letters Sans is approachable and contemporary, while Dogica earns its keep big and brief.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-heebo: Dogica stretches heavy letters wide, lowercase rising close to capitals. Heebo gives text a tall central band with curves that stop short, a sturdy counterweight to the loud heading.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-hind-guntur: Dogica is heavy, wide and commanding, its lowercase nearly capital height. Hind Guntur draws like a technical drafting pen, with wide gaps between curve ends and stems, and that precision is the pair's best quality.
